## MCP - Script Detector

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/script-detector

**Purpose:** Detect writing script (hebrew, arabic, latin, etc.) from text, images, or PDFs.

**InputSchema:**
```json
{
  "required": [],
  "properties": {
    "user_id": { "type": "string", "description": "ID utilisateur (credits, quotas)" },
    "guild_id": { "type": "string", "description": "ID serveur Discord" },
    "user_request": { "type": "string", "description": "Requete utilisateur originale" },
    "text": { "type": "string", "description": "Texte a analyser (mode gratuit Unicode)" },
    "image_url": { "type": "string", "description": "URL de l'image a analyser" },
    "image_base64": { "type": "string", "description": "Image en base64 (alternative a image_url)" },
    "file_url": { "type": "string", "description": "URL du fichier (PDF ou image)" }
  }
}
```

**Note:** API keys fournies par le systeme via openai_api_key.

**Analyzable:**
```json
{
  "accepts_image": true,
  "accepts_media": true,
  "output_fields": ["primary_script", "scripts", "is_rtl", "recommended_providers"],
  "domain": "script_detection"
}
```

---

### Mode 1: Text (GRATUIT - analyse Unicode)
```json
{ "text": "שלום עולם Hello" }
```

### Mode 2: Image (OpenAI Vision)
```json
{
  "image_url": "https://...",
  "openai_api_key": "sk-..."
}
```

### Mode 3: PDF (Vision sur page 1)
```json
{
  "file_url": "https://...document.pdf",
  "openai_api_key": "sk-..."
}
```

**Scripts:** hebrew, arabic, latin, cyrillic, greek, han, hiragana, katakana, hangul, thai, devanagari, tamil, etc.
